title: Introductory Portuguese Studies I
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText: You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed any of the following courses: PORT1002, PORT2001, PORT2002, PORT6501, PORT6502, PORT6503 or PORT6504.

title: Introductory Portuguese Studies II
college: ANU College of Arts and Social Sciences
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed PORT1001, or have equivalent level of language proficiency as demonstrated by placement test, or with permission of the convener.
You are not able to enrol in this course if you have previously completed any of the following courses: PORT2001, PORT2002, PORT6502, PORT6503 or PORT6504.
